Hi Simon — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: We covered your multi-team use case (product search personalization + analytics reranking) and constraints around data residency and low 99th percentile latency for Europe.
- Goal: Schedule a technical deep dive/demo with engineering (30–45 min) where we will: walk architecture, discuss model sizing/throughput, and review routing/fallback policies.

Availability ask: To make it easier for global stakeholders across Novacorp (US product, EU infra, APAC ops), would you be open to a rotating weekly timeband? The idea: rotate the deep-dive slot between US-friendly, EU-friendly, and APAC-friendly windows so each region occasionally gets daytime slots for deep technical sessions.

Proposal (week 1 = US slot, week 2 = EU slot, week 3 = APAC slot, repeat):
- US slot: Tue 10:00 PT / 13:00 ET
- EU slot: Wed 15:00 CET / 14:00 UK
- APAC slot: Thu 09:30 SGT / 11:30 AEST

I attached a quick availability matrix that I captured from your notes — feel free to edit and share back. If that cadence looks reasonable, we can lock a first session for next week (US slot) and invite Ben (solutions), Vivek (inference), and Marissa (CS).

Next steps: can you confirm: 1) rotating cadence acceptable, 2) any blackout dates for March, and 3) who from Novacorp needs to attend (engineer names preferred)?

Thanks — I’ll hold pockets on our side until I hear back.
